propositions: ADR 0035 §(d) lacks concrete backend interface specification, blocking decomposition and plan-review of Phase 2 implementation stories S2–S5
The backend interface must pin four design decisions: rebar as canonical model, core owns diff/apply, role Protocols behind Backend facade, and RemoteRef type for identity tuples

Five role Protocols (TicketTransport, OutboundMapper, InboundMapper, FieldSanitizer, IdentityConvention) and three capability Protocols (SupportsLinks, SupportsComments, SupportsIncremental) must be formally named and documented in §(d)
RemoteRef must replace hardcoded 'jira' literal in apply_inbound_records.py and bare jira_key references to provide vendor-agnostic identity handling
Three leak-fixes must be addressed: ADF-sizing removed from differ, lossy status/parent rules moved to Jira adapter, and duplicated value-maps/link-constants consolidated
